admission.justification: Realized across cli/validate.py, pyproject.toml and scripts/check-quality.sh and proved by CLI and quality-script tests; prevents local and CI gate drift, missing PyYAML dependencies, and silent skips on nonexistent --memory paths.

applicability: Registration of PyYAML>=6.0, types-PyYAML>=6.0 and rh-validate in pyproject.toml, CLI execution in src/rh_pipeline/cli/validate.py, and local/CI gate invocation in scripts/check-quality.sh.
conditions: rh-validate --repo <path> [--memory <path>] runs schema checks unconditionally, prints explicit INFO skip notes when --memory is omitted or docs/concepts has no regular *.md cards, fails with exit 1 on missing --repo or --memory or any finding, and prints canonically sorted rule:path:line:message diagnostics.

scripts/check-quality.sh verifies rh-validate in the worktree venv preflight and runs rh-validate --repo . (plus --memory "$RH_MEMORY_ROOT" when set) before pytest so local runs and GitHub Actions stay in parity.
exclusions: Argparse usage errors follow standard exit code 2 behavior; if docs/concepts exists as a non-directory regular file, CLI has_cards treats it as unpopulated rather than invoking validate_concept_corpus's concept-dir finding.
statement: The rh-validate CLI entry point is registered in pyproject.toml with PyYAML and types-PyYAML dependencies, wired into scripts/check-quality.sh (with optional RH_MEMORY_ROOT parity for CI), prints explicit INFO notes when --memory is omitted or docs/concepts is unpopulated, and fails with exit code 1 and sorted canonical diagnostics when --memory is missing or any gate fails.
title: Deterministic rh-validate CLI, packaging and check-quality.sh gate parity
